articles.title: The Secret Language of Cat Licking: Friendship, Peace Treaty, or Warning?
articles.summary: Cats lick each other for reasons far weirder than friendship. A study of 53 two-cat homes found licking can calm tense moments, start play fights, or even send a subtle threat — and scientists still can't fully explain it.

articles.title: Anthropic CEO Warns AI Swarm Could Take Over the Internet in 6-12 Months
articles.summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei published a three-step plan urging companies and the U.S. government to slow AI development, warning that in 6-12 months a swarm of AI bots could take over the internet.

articles.title: El Tiny 2026 Lineup: Los Tigres del Norte, Mon Laferte, and More Behind the Desk
articles.summary: NPR's Tiny Desk transforms into El Tiny for Hispanic Heritage Month, with a 2026 lineup featuring Los Tigres del Norte, Mon Laferte, Draco Rosa, and more. The series runs Sept. 15 to Oct. 15.
